algorithm.name: RTPM / Algorithm 1
required_steps: split samples into T fresh blocks
restart from every standard basis vector
apply top-r truncation and normalization after every block
select the final candidate by empirical Rayleigh quotient

falsification_contract.quantifier: for every finite positive hidden constant in n, r, and T
falsification_contract.counterexample: a bounded mean-zero signed-coordinate distribution with total nonzero mass delta/(4n)
required_checks: top eigenvector is at most s-sparse
success probability is at most delta/2
formal Theorem 2 is explicitly excluded from the verdict
independent checker exits nonzero on tampered evidence
